def: to cleanse, i.e. (specially) to prune; figuratively, to expiate

occurrences.text: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
